items.title: Is Simon Property Stock Underperforming the Nasdaq?
items.summary: Simon Property has underperformed the Nasdaq over the past year, but analysts are cautiously optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Nike and This Retail Giant Will No Longer Be Part of This Prestigious S&P Index
items.summary: On Sept. 21, both Nike and Simon Property Group will be dropped from the S&P 100 Index, although they will remain a part of the broader S&P 500 Index.

items.title: Nike, Simon Property Group dropped from S&P 100
items.summary: The shift, effective Sept. 21, is mostly symbolic, especially for the mall company. But for the apparel brand it’s a fresh reminder of ongoing struggles.

items.title: Why SNDK, DELL, PANW Stocks Are Rallying Overnight Ahead Of Fresh Trading Week
items.summary: SanDisk jumped 3.6% overnight after its S&P 100 inclusion, extending a nearly 12% Friday surge.

items.title: The S&P 100 ETF Just Dumped Nike and Colgate for 4 AI Stocks. Here’s What That Means for Your Portfolio
items.summary: The iShares S&P 100 ETF just swapped out a toothpaste giant and a mall REIT for four AI infrastructure plays, and the move reveals something uncomfortable about what this so-called blue-chip fund has quietly become.

items.title: How Investors May Respond To Simon Property Group (SPG) Launching Its Simon Media Network Advertising Platform
items.summary: In August 2026, Simon Property Group launched Simon Media Network, a commerce media platform that lets brands reach high-intent shoppers across more than 200 Simon destinations using first-party consumer data and integrated digital, experiential, and online channels. This move turns Simon’s vast mall traffic and over US$100.00 billion in annual on-site commerce into a new advertising and insights business built on real-world consumer behavior signals. items.title: Nike Exits the S&P 100 Index. 4 Tech Stocks Move In
items.summary: Nike drops out of the S&P 100 on September 21, 2026. Dell, Palo Alto, Arista and Sandisk move in, signaling a major shift toward tech stocks.
